skill.summary: Turn a 3-minute MP3 podcast recording into 1080p audio-driven MP4 just by typing what you need. Whether it's uploading audio files to create shareable video...

latestVersion.changelog:
Audio Upload AIOZ 1.0.0 — Initial release

- Instantly convert audio files (MP3, WAV, AAC, M4A) into 1080p video (MP4) with custom prompts.
- One-step upload and render workflow: no timeline editing or export settings required.
- Supports instructions such as waveform visualizers, text overlays, background images, and more.
- Cloud-powered GPU rendering, typically ready to download in 30–60 seconds for short audio.
- Automatic session and token handling with user-friendly setup confirmation.
- Export in multiple formats; includes error handling and clear workflow guidance.
